# Heiltrank

General equipment with a picture and an effect: the swap bag at the
right, the effect under its caption, the picture in the room that is
left. The German half of a bilingual pair — the deck prints `de` and
leaves `Healing-Potion` out. Invented for this deck.

```cardsmith
card:
  system: mini-d20
  card-type: equipment
  language: de
data:
  name: Heiltrank
  equipment-type: Allgemein
  price: 25 GM
  effect: "Heilt 10 TP. Wirkt sofort, auch bei 0 TP."
  notes: "Ein Trank je Kampf."
  image: "[[Heiltrank.png]]"
  reference: Regelwerk S. 17
```
